status: Retrospective development extension; not preregistered. Recipes written before the new render run; existing data and old results already inspected. No winner quota.

composition.loss: total variation: sum absolute share errors / 2
composition.cases: First canonical comparison per primary resource: each group binned into four pooled-quartile categories (18); cohort label shares in six unpaired resources (6); 48 synthetic Dirichlet compositions, K=2,3,5,8, concentrations .3,1,5, four replicates each.

profile.loss: mean absolute value error / sample SD of 12 target values
profile.cases: All 19 wrist records with >=12 observations and every one of 53 BIDMC source recordings with >=12 valid HR values; record-level examples, not independent participants. 12 equal-duration bins; missing bins excluded as documented.

association.cases: All 53 BIDMC recordings; valid paired HR/PULSE readings, systematic at most 64 evenly spaced rows. Density heatmap is 16x16 bins. No independent patient claim.

controls: Per-task fixed default (bar for composition, line for profile, scatter for association); reference-selected winner frozen for transfer; test oracle descriptive only. Report ties within loss 1e-12 and failures. No overall leaderboard across tasks.
scope: 13 chart families across task contracts including legacy original seven; no claim all 15 catalogued families are implemented.
